summary_1line: Krishna nearly breaks his vow to attack Bhishma; later the Pandavas seek Bhishma’s counsel and learn he can be defeated if Arjuna fights him behind Shikhandi.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna, eyes blazing and whip in hand, leaps from Arjuna’s chariot and charges toward Bhishma like a storm cloud streaked with lightning.
Arjuna clings to Krishna’s legs on the battlefield, desperately stopping him from breaking his vow as armies watch in stunned silence.
At night in Bhishma’s tent, the unarmed Pandavas bow before their grandsire while he calmly explains the way they must defeat him.
